key_insight: Repeated-sampling objectives reduce sharpening by shifting learning pressure toward harder prompts, and standard single-completion objectives can recover the same optimal policies with prompt-adaptive adjustments.
engineering_relevance: KAPPO adapts existing policy optimization methods to repeated-sampling objectives without changing their training procedures, enabling lower-cost control over behavioral coverage.
method: Derive closed-form optimal policies for KL-regularized pass@k and max@k objectives.
Recover those optima using prompt-adaptive regularization or reward transformation.
Apply KAPPO after a one-time reference calibration.
evidence_signal: Experiments across several RL methods on mathematical reasoning and code generation report sharpening control and single-completion training that matches multi-completion optimizers at a fraction of the cost.
watch_item: KAPPO requires reference calibration; the abstract does not quantify calibration overhead or sensitivity to its accuracy.
